The **biggest failure is architecture**. There is maybe one good comedic scene’s worth of material here, but I treated it as though repetition could manufacture a whole song out of it. It can’t. The “I laughed, coughed, lost the thought…” sequence appears over and over before the main verse has even developed the premise. That destroys forward motion. Instead of **setup → escalation → complication → payoff → callback**, it becomes **setup → repeat setup → repeat setup → repeat setup → finally continue**.
